segment: A0-DEF-3 is repaired: the staged native runtime source in the serving composition is now one consistent generation, so the daemon's declared lifetime and the runtime's expectation agree

defect.exact_mechanism: the staged native runtime source of the serving composition was a MIXED generation: scripts/a0_runtime.py, scripts/rootless_docker_launch.py and plugins/friday_rework/adapters/a0_web.py came from the generation that declares a daemon lifetime of 480 s, while scripts/friday-rework-docker.service and a0_profile.py came from the generation that declares 120 s. The installed runtime's host_daemon_seconds() requires runtime == DAEMON_SECONDS (480) and the unit's own RuntimeMaxUSec is 2min (120 s), so every attempt was refused with host_daemon_original_deadline_changed before any container was created.
defect.relation_to_the_disk_cleanup: the four diverging files are exactly the ones whose pinned bytes were removed by the cleanup of 2026-11-08, so the staging area was left with a mixture of the two generations
defect.repair: the staged native runtime source is published as one consistent set from the candidate, whose unit file declares RuntimeMaxSec=480s and whose a0_prepare checks exactly that value; the staged a0_runtime.py, rootless_docker_launch.py, the unit file, a0_profile.py and a0_web.py are now byte-identical to the candidate
defect.verified: the same publication was proven on the isolated composition before it was applied; after it all five staged files match the candidate and the receipt, the marker and the ordinary_gateway phase pin one receipt

publication_mechanism.added: the transaction can now publish files at an explicit path inside the home, declared by the request, with the path relative to the home and never escaping it; the staged native runtime source is published through it
publication_mechanism.why: the staged source lives in home/worker-runtime-source and is not part of the plugin set, so the previous mechanism could not reach it
